case.background: Test bodies orbit one fixed central star. Determine how orbital period depends on semi-major axis and eccentricity within the available stable orbits.
initial_observations: Each orbit closes and repeats with the reported period.

instruments.description: A synthetic observatory that places a negligible-mass test body on a stable elliptical orbit around the same reference star and times complete revolutions.
instruments.name: ideal_orbit_observatory

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: orbital_period_days. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.
